svg.title: 388 pauses into host RAM, 388 bit-exact resumes
svg.desc: 33 runs of 9 workload types. Each output matched an uninterrupted run. One blue square per completed bit-exact pause/resume cycle; gaps separate runs. Cells sweep left to right, orange while paused for 0.4 seconds, then blue on resume; the counter counts completed resumes. MLP: 106 cycles, 8 runs; transformer with fp16 autocast and gradient accumulation: 86 cycles, 6 runs; CNN with cuDNN: 41 cycles, 3 runs; torch.compile: 40 cycles, 3 runs; CUDA graph replay: 25 cycles, 3 runs; DataLoader with worker processes: 41 cycles, 3 runs; two threads on separate streams: 28 cycles, 3 runs; Qwen3-1.7B generation: 11 cycles, 2 runs; single-GPU NCCL: 10 cycles, 2 runs. Not counted: 5 runs on gpu1 that never paused (4 single-GPU NCCL, 1 managed memory), listed as hazards in the gpunap README.

g.data-workload: transformer with fp16 autocast and gradient accumulation
